summary: Manulife Private Credit Fund (MPCF) filed an 8-K to disclose entry into a merger agreement with John Hancock Comvest Private Income Fund (JHCPIF) and related parties. Under the agreement, Merger Sub will merge into MPCF, which then merges into JHCPIF, with JHCPIF surviving. MPCF shares will convert into JHCPIF Class I shares based on an exchange ratio determined from post-closing NAV calculations. Boards of both BDCs approved the deal; it is intended to be tax-free as a reorganization. No price per share, premium, or break fee is stated. While this is a merger, the filing appears to be a routine agreement disclosure rather than a special situation triggering activist or strategic review; the event—a BDC merger—is common and lacks terms that would mark it as a distinct special situation. A non-US equivalent is not needed; this is US-based.
